TAB: Definitions
- Latency p50/p95: server-side end-to-end request latency as reported by Redwood Console unless otherwise stated. Must specify streaming vs non-streaming.
- TTFT: time to first token (streaming). Only use if we can measure consistently (Console or agreed method).
- Error rate: (5xx + timeouts) / total requests over window. If including 429, label separately as rate-limit events.
- Throughput: sustained requests/sec OR tokens/sec at a stated concurrency and with stated prompt/response token distributions.
- Cost metrics:
  - Preferred: cost per 1K tokens (split input vs output if possible).
  - For retrieval apps: cost per query must define which components are included (embed, rerank, generate).

TAB: Screenshots/Links (paste targets)
- Redwood Console dashboard links: add when created (do NOT include customer identifiers in URLs when sharing externally).
- Benchmark reports: store in shared drive folder /go-to-market/reference-program/benchmarks/ (internal only).

Global notes / guardrails (for publish):
1) Every numeric claim needs: window, model version, region/deployment mode, and whether caching/batching/quantization were enabled.
2) If baseline is from a different provider/hardware, publish deltas carefully and include caveats (or publish Redwood-only outcomes such as “met SLO” instead of “X% faster”).
3) For regulated customers: avoid infrastructure diagrams that reveal network topology, account IDs, VPC CIDRs, or security control specifics beyond approved statements.
4) Final metric lock happens BEFORE design: once numbers are in the PDF/web draft, changes become expensive and trigger re-approval.
